units.rawText: We've wiped them all out! Now only Omega's left.
units.displayText: We've wiped them all out! Now only Omega's left.

spans.text: We've wiped them all out! Now only Omega's left.

units.rawText: Nascita looks at Omega under the mask of Mysterious Warrior N, and complex emotions churn in her heart.
units.displayText: Nascita looks at Omega under the mask of Mysterious Warrior N, and complex emotions churn in her heart.

spans.text: Nascita looks at Omega under the mask of Mysterious Warrior N, and complex emotions churn in her heart.

units.rawText: (Even if the script's been changed and I'm fighting for justice now, I'm sure there are people who think that I must be pretty scary right now.)
units.displayText: Even if the script's been changed and I'm fighting for justice now, I'm sure there are people who think that I must be pretty scary right now.

spans.text: Even if the script's been changed and I'm fighting for justice now, I'm sure there are people who think that I must be pretty scary right now.

units.rawText: (But that's okay, right, Sol?)
units.displayText: But that's okay, right, Sol?

spans.text: But that's okay, right, Sol?

units.rawText: (At the very least, I understand now that the one standing in my way of being a hero was myself... You were right, I already had a heart of justice.)
units.displayText: At the very least, I understand now that the one standing in my way of being a hero was myself... You were right, I already had a heart of justice.

spans.text: At the very least, I understand now that the one standing in my way of being a hero was myself... You were right, I already had a heart of justice.

units.rawText: (I will walk out of those denials from my memories and step over my self-loathing that I couldn't talk about before. I will become a hero of justice, and then spread my love and hope to everyone.)
units.displayText: I will walk out of those denials from my memories and step over my self-loathing that I couldn't talk about before. I will become a hero of justice, and then spread my love and hope to everyone.

spans.text: I will walk out of those denials from my memories and step over my self-loathing that I couldn't talk about before. I will become a hero of justice, and then spread my love and hope to everyone.

units.rawText: (No matter how long a road I have to walk.)
units.displayText: No matter how long a road I have to walk.

spans.text: No matter how long a road I have to walk.

units.rawText: Omega, no, KTV Agent 1... If you can be reset, I want to share my answer with you too.
units.displayText: Omega, no, KTV Agent 1... If you can be reset, I want to share my answer with you too.

spans.text: Omega, no, KTV Agent 1... If you can be reset, I want to share my answer with you too.

units.rawText: But right now, I need to carry out my own responsibilities.
units.displayText: But right now, I need to carry out my own responsibilities.

spans.text: But right now, I need to carry out my own responsibilities.

units.rawText: Upon hearing Nascita mutter to herself, Sol tilts her head and smiles.
units.displayText: Upon hearing Nascita mutter to herself, Sol tilts her head and smiles.

spans.text: Upon hearing Nascita mutter to herself, Sol tilts her head and smiles.

units.rawText: How about it? Did you reach a conclusion, Mysterious Warrior N?
units.displayText: How about it? Did you reach a conclusion, Mysterious Warrior N?

spans.text: How about it? Did you reach a conclusion, Mysterious Warrior N?

units.rawText: Let's deal with this guy who's suddenly spaced out first, then we can slowly settle things between us.
units.displayText: Let's deal with this guy who's suddenly spaced out first, then we can slowly settle things between us.

spans.text: Let's deal with this guy who's suddenly spaced out first, then we can slowly settle things between us.

units.rawText: <size=28>Wasn't all that muttering-darkly-to-yourself-stuff just now spacing out too...</size>
units.displayText: Wasn't all that muttering-darkly-to-yourself-stuff just now spacing out too...

spans.text: Wasn't all that muttering-darkly-to-yourself-stuff just now spacing out too...

units.rawText: Ahem... At the very least, we're fighting together right now.
units.displayText: Ahem... At the very least, we're fighting together right now.

spans.text: Ahem... At the very least, we're fighting together right now.

units.rawText: It's very hard to avoid self-doubt. Anyone will have to go through that, no matter who they are.
units.displayText: It's very hard to avoid self-doubt. Anyone will have to go through that, no matter who they are.

spans.text: It's very hard to avoid self-doubt. Anyone will have to go through that, no matter who they are.

units.rawText: But heroes are people who can ignore the voices which question themselves in order to get through to their hearts of justice!
units.displayText: But heroes are people who can ignore the voices which question themselves in order to get through to their hearts of justice!

spans.text: But heroes are people who can ignore the voices which question themselves in order to get through to their hearts of justice!

units.rawText: Well said. If we weren't fighting right now, I'd even applaud you!
units.displayText: Well said. If we weren't fighting right now, I'd even applaud you!

units.rawText: Now then, "Are you ready?"
units.displayText: Now then, "Are you ready?"

spans.text: Now then, "Are you ready?"

units.rawText: Of course. I've always been ready for this day.
units.displayText: Of course. I've always been ready for this day.

spans.text: Of course. I've always been ready for this day.
